name: a-string-tells-its-head-its-tail-and-its-characters
query: 1000 | range | map ~("ab") | join "" | excerpt 80 | get [/characters ~(print | count | lte 80) ~(get /head | startsWith "ab")]

name: a-map-tells-the-entries-at-its-two-ends
query: 100 | range | map ~(get [~(toString | append "k" | toKeyword) ~(it)]) | toMap | excerpt 120 | get [/count ~(get /first | keys | first) ~(get /last | keys | last)]

name: a-trace-tells-the-steps-that-failed
query: kinds | add 1 !| trace | excerpt | get [/failed ~(get /subject | startsWith "#[::absent")]

name: an-excerpt-reads-back-as-itself
query: 1000 | range | excerpt | :e it | print | parse | open | eq e

name: a-map-whose-end-holds-no-entry-whole-tells-the-ends-of-its-print
query: get {:rows ~(5000 | range) :name "x"} | excerpt | get [/count ~(get /head | startsWith "{:rows [0 1") ~(get /tail | endsWith ":name \"x\"}")]

name: a-cut-of-a-print-falls-where-a-word-ends
query: kinds | add 1 !| trace | excerpt | get /subject | split " " | filter ~(anyOf (eq "…") (startsWith "::") (startsWith "#[::") | not)

name: a-cut-stays-within-a-word-where-no-space-lies-in-the-half-beside-it
query: get [~(400 | range | map ~("x") | join "") " yyy"] | join "" | excerpt 80 | get [~(get /tail | startsWith "x") ~(get /tail | endsWith " yyy")]
